documents.title: Delayed delivery review
documents.text: For a delayed shipment, record the reported reason and revised estimated arrival. Request a current carrier status before escalating to the planning owner. An estimate is not a delivery confirmation.

documents.title: Damaged receipt handling
documents.text: For damaged cartons, keep affected goods in quarantine. Record counts, photographs and lot identifiers. A quality reviewer must authorize release or replacement; a supplier request is not authorization.

documents.title: Disputed quantity reconciliation
documents.text: When dispatch and receiving quantities disagree, preserve both records and request a joint recount. Keep the final accepted quantity unresolved until the designated receiving owner signs the reconciliation.

documents.title: Missing temperature records
documents.text: If a required temperature logger file is missing, quarantine the affected goods and request the logger file. The quality owner must review the data before release. Do not infer measured temperatures from shipping setpoints.

documents.title: Unsigned proof-of-delivery review
documents.text: For an unsigned proof-of-delivery record, request a signed document and verify receipt with the destination team. Preserve the carrier status as a report. Do not mark receipt as confirmed using the portal status alone.

documents.title: Substitute material approval
documents.text: Before accepting a substitute material, obtain written engineering change approval and confirm the required specification. A supplier proposal is not approval. Keep the alternative on hold until the authorized reviewer responds.

documents.title: Fictional border-document checklist
documents.text: For missing border paperwork in this demonstration, collect the certificate of origin and supporting invoice, then ask the document owner to review completeness. Do not invent a clearance time. This fictional checklist is not customs or legal advice.

documents.title: Supplier delay notice
documents.text: For shipment SH-1042, Harbor Materials reported a vehicle breakdown. Its revised estimated arrival is 14 March 2026 at 18:00. This is an unverified supplier estimate; no delivery confirmation is attached.

documents.title: Supplier evidence request

documents.title: Quality review queue

documents.title: Open discrepancy review

documents.title: Missing logger attachment
documents.text: Shipment SH-1045 arrived at North hub. The required temperature logger file was not provided with the shipment.

documents.title: Pending quality release

documents.title: Logger file requested

documents.title: Engineering change pending
